integrity: Natural integral chain-level first-homology comparison is proved with explicit cubical relations. Exact finite tests compare integer lattices and certify a projective-plane order-two example; tests do not replace general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only degrees zero and one for finite hypergraphs whose vertices belong to nonempty hyperedges; no assertion concerning higher cubical homology or hypergraph-homotopy invariance. Equivalent unpublished results cannot be excluded.
title: First integral \(\Gamma\)-homology of a hypergraph equals simplicial first homology of its downward closure
